title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Senior IT Support Engineer
description:
Job Description

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S. , serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus . We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history —and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.


We’re seeking an experienced Senior IT Support Engineer to join our growing team in a dynamic, remote-first startup environment. The ideal candidate will bring outstanding IT support skills, a deep understanding of cloud-managed infrastructure, and expertise in supporting a globally distributed workforce. You’ll be responsible for providing top-tier support to our global user base and ensuring smooth daily operations across hardware, software, network, and collaboration tools. If you have a proactive attitude, strong technical skills, and an interest in AI technologies, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Remotely design, manage, and troubleshoot IT infrastructure, including cloud-managed networks (LAN/Wi-Fi), and firewalls for our physical office hubs.
  • Lead IT infrastructure and collaboration technology projects for a distributed workforce, ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
  • Manage and enhance Workspace ONE UEM deployments for zero-touch device provisioning, lifecycle management, and security compliance.
  • Drive IT automation initiatives using scripting tools or low-code/no-code platforms to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
  • Act as a customer experience champion, ensuring responsive, high-quality support for all employees, regardless of their location.
  • Provide expert IT support for our global teams across the US, India, LATAM, and Europe.
  • Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, security settings, integrations, and advanced troubleshooting.
  • Oversee the end-to-end IT asset lifecycle for a remote workforce, including procurement, zero-touch deployment, tracking, and secure decommissioning.
  • Support and optimize collaboration tools like Slack, Jira Service Management, Zoom, Confluence, and Google Meet.
  • Standardize and document IT processes, creating robust knowledge bases and support procedures for a remote-first environment.
  • Lead remote onboarding and offboarding operations, coordinating closely with Compliance, People, and Security teams.
  • Contribute to IT compliance efforts (SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS) within a cloud-native infrastructure.


Skills and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of IT Experience, ideally with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role supporting a remote or hybrid workforce. English is a MUST have.
  • Proven experience providing exceptional IT support to a globally distributed, remote workforce.
  • Experience supporting Mac, Linux, and Windows platforms in a corporate environment.
  • Strong expertise in networking principles (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN)
  • Demonstrated success in driving IT automation or process improvements with measurable outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience managing a distributed IT asset lifecycle using modern asset management tools.
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace administration and automation.
  • Solid experience with Workspace ONE UEM or other modern MDM/UEM solutions (e.g., Jamf, Kandji, Intune).
  • Exceptional documentation, project management, and cross-team collaboration skills, essential for a remote-first environment.
  • Prior experience in a startup, fast-paced, or agile environment is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC2, PCI, ISO 27001.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-focused mindset.
  • Passion for leveraging AI tools in IT operations or familiarity with emerging AI-enhanced IT solutions.



As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, Rain is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sex (including pregnancy), protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any unlawful criterion existing under applicable federal, state, or local laws. title: Gerente Técnico de Inteligência Artificial - Brasil
description:
Você na Deloitte

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Gerente Técnico de Inteligência Artificial, no time de Artificial Intelligence & Data. Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Liderar a definição de arquiteturas de referência para soluções de IA, Machine Learning, LLMs e Visão Computacional , considerando boas práticas de escalabilidade, segurança e governança.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e desenvolvedores, apoiando decisões de design e implementação.
  • Participar ativamente em propostas comerciais , trazendo visão técnica para novos negócios e validando a viabilidade de soluções junto a clientes.
  • Conduzir revisões técnicas de código, modelos e pipelines , garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência às normas regulatórias e éticas.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento (P&D) para novos produtos e soluções proprietárias em IA.
  • Interagir com stakeholders de alto nível (C-level, diretores, gerentes de tecnologia e negócios), traduzindo desafios estratégicos em soluções técnicas viáveis.
  • Atuar como mentor na evolução técnica da equipe, promovendo capacitação em ferramentas modernas de IA, MLOps e Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) .

Os líderes da Deloitte vivem o nosso propósito: gerar impactos positivos. Energizam, empoderam, conectam, interagem, reagem e pensam de formas diferentes. Por isso, buscamos pessoas que são inspiradoras, criam ambientes diversos, influenciam uma cultura colaborativa e, com isso, entregam valor. Nossa liderança é peça-chave para o nosso crescimento.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.


O que precisa para você se candidatar à vaga?

- Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.

- Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica de projetos de inteligência artificial ou ciência de dados em consultoria ou grandes empresas.

- Conhecimento avançado em Python , frameworks de IA/ML (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face) e bibliotecas para NLP e CV.

- Domínio de arquiteturas de LLMs e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) , pipelines de MLOps e boas práticas de implantação em produção.

- Experiência em cloud computing (GCP, AWS ou Azure) e computação paralela.

- Forte habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de interagir com clientes de diferentes níveis de maturidade tecnológica.

-Inglês fluente.

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social

(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*

*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

Esperamos você neste time!

title: Especialista em SRE
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Você fará parte do time de SRE/DevSecOps responsável por uma plataforma de dados e inteligência artificial em arquitetura Cloud Native, base estratégica para diversos produtos da companhia.

Será um papel essencial na evolução técnica e cultural da infraestrutura, garantindo confiabilidade, escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência operacional.

A pessoa nessa posição liderará iniciativas de automação, observabilidade e resiliência, além de capacitar outras equipes a entregarem software com mais qualidade, agilidade e segurança.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Monitorar continuamente a saúde dos sistemas, criar alertas eficazes e garantir cobertura proativa de incidentes.
  • Responder rapidamente a incidentes críticos, coordenando mitigação, comunicação e resolução.
  • Gerir mudanças, atualizações e implantações com foco em segurança, estabilidade e disponibilidade.
  • Construir e manter pipelines, bibliotecas e automações para provisionamento, deploy e operação em ambientes Cloud de alta disponibilidade.
  • Estabelecer e garantir padrões de security by design em infraestrutura, código e dados.
  • Projetar e evoluir soluções de observabilidade ponta a ponta, integrando logs, métricas, traces e eventos.
  • Gerenciar e melhorar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs, MTTR, MTTA).
  • Conduzir post-mortems blameless e implementar ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Influenciar decisões arquiteturais e operacionais visando resiliência, escalabilidade e custo eficiente.
  • Documentar padrões técnicos, playbooks e comunicar impactos técnicos em linguagem de negócio.
  • Definir prioridades estratégicas do backlog de SRE, equilibrando confiabilidade, velocidade de entrega, segurança e custos.
  • Apoiar auditorias, conformidade e governança de segurança em alinhamento com times de risco e compliance.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Domínio de conceitos avançados de SRE, DevSecOps e gestão de incidentes.
  • Automação de infraestrutura e pipelines em alto nível, utilizando Shell, Python, Go, Node.js ou Groovy.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade distribuída (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/Elastic Stack, Datadog, New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Atuação sólida com Cloud pública (GCP, AWS ou equivalente), incluindo provisionamento, automação e otimização de custos.
  • Experiência em CI/CD e DevSecOps avançado, com ferramentas como Git/GitOps, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Maven, SonarQube/Cloud.
  • Proficiência em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Chef).
  • Vivência com serviços de mensageria e data streaming como Kafka, Redis Streams, Google Pub/Sub, Dataflow.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo PostgreSQL, AloyDB, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, BigQuery.
  • Experiência em gestão de incidentes e troubleshooting em sistemas complexos, utilizando PagerDuty, Opsgenie, StatusPage, Splunk ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação, compliance e governança de ambientes cloud (LGPD, Privacy by Design, SAST/DAST, IAM, Secret Management).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de alto volume de dados, tráfego e experiência com design resiliente.
  • Experiência ou interesse em DataOps/MLOps, atuando com pipelines de dados e IA em larga escala (desejável).
  • Background em arquitetura e desenvolvimento de software, com domínio de versionamento, APIs, microserviços e padrões REST/gRPC.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares).
  • Uso de IA assistiva e ferramentas de produtividade como GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT ou similares (diferencial).
  • Capacidade de mentorar e influenciar tecnicamente outros times, promovendo cultura de automação, segurança e confiabilidade e fomentando a cultura de ownership sobre sistemas em produção.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações relevantes (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Security+).
  • Experiência com Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) e políticas de segurança zero-trust.
  • Conhecimento em FinOps e gestão de custos em ambientes distribuídos.
  • Experiência com blue/green deployments, canary releases e chaos engineering.
  • Experiência com padronização de deploys por templates (Helm/Kustomize).

Job Title: Smartsheet Solution Architect

Location: Remote in LATAM (EST time zone required)

We are seeking a highly experienced and certified Smartsheet Solution Architect & PMO Leader to drive the strategic design, implementation, and optimization of our work management and Project Portfolio Management (PPM) solutions.   • Design and Architect Solutions: Lead the end-to-end architectural design and development of complex, integrated Smartsheet solutions, including utilizing premium applications like Control Center, Resource Management, and Dynamic View, to meet Gordian's strategic business needs.
  • Platform Optimization: Act as the Smartsheet expert and Administrator , continuously optimizing the platform for performance, scalability, and user experience.
  • Governance and Standards: Establish and enforce Smartsheet governance, best practices, and standardization for dashboards, reporting, automation, and data integrity across the organization.
  • Stakeholder Mobilization: Introduce and drive adoption of the Smartsheet platform and its capabilities across all levels of company leadership.
  • Design Excellence: Provide expert consultation on the visual design and structural layout of sheets , dashboards, and reports, ensuring they are intuitive, aesthetically pleasing, and aligned with user experience best practices. Project & Program Management Office (PMO) Leadership
  • PMO Implementation: Establish, lead, and mature the PMO function —defining, documenting, and implementing project management standards, best practices, and procedures (PMP methodologies).
  • PPM Tool Implementation: Establish and lead the use of Smartsheetas the primary PPM tool for enterprise-wide intake, demand, and resource management, portfolio management, and real-time status reporting.
  • Strategic Alignment: Charter and lead executive-level bodies, such as a Steering Committee or Project Review Board (PRB), to ensure project and program portfolios are aligned with strategic goals and organizational objectives.
  • Process Improvement: Drive measurable improvements in project delivery metrics, such as increasing on-time completion rates and enhancing strategic focus through effective prioritization methods.


Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience

  • Progressive leadership experience in Project Management, Program Management, and/or PMO Director roles.
  • Expert-level experience in Smartsheet development, configuration, and administration, with a proven track record of implementing the platform in multiple corporate environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in establishing, leading, and maturing a corporate PMO from the ground up, including hiring and managing a team of Project Managers, Business Analysts, and Scrum Masters.
  • Experience managing multiple project portfolios (e.g., infrastructure, application development) valued over $10M each and managing over 300 concurrent projects.
  • Experience in change management and successfully integrating new processes and teams following acquisitions or mergers.
  • Design sensibility and UX expertise with the ability to evaluate and provide constructive feedback on sheet design, layout optimization, color schemes, formatting, and overall visual presentation to enhance usability and user adoption.


Certifications

  • Smartsheet Solution Architect Certified (Essential)
  • Smartsheet Certified Solution Consultant (Highly preferred)
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) (Essential)
  • Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) (Preferred)
  • Certified Agile Practitioner (PMI-ACP) (Preferred)


Education & Logistics

  • Education: Master’s degree in project management or a related field is highly desirable
  • Work Hours: This role will primarily operate on Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours to align with company operations.
  • Location: Remote

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our U.S. client's DevOps team. In this role, you will fully automate provisioning, deployment, management, and monitoring for a rapidly evolving and highly scalable set of SaaS products. You will work closely with members of the DevOps team, alongside a DevOps architect, to ensure best practices are implemented across applications. This will involve leading teams on critical initiatives, such as CI/CD and enterprise monitoring, and supporting operational services. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, and collaborative teamwork.

The right candidate is someone who:

  • Thrives on owning critical systems and takes pride in driving uptime, reliability, and robust incident management
  • Gets energized by designing, building, and scaling automation tooling that empowers other teams and streamlines cross-functional workflows
  • Enjoys championing process improvements, standardizing deployment and reliability practices, and influencing engineering maturity across an organization
  • Displays natural curiosity, constantly measuring, experimenting, and improving from DORA metrics to incident response, and gains fulfillment from reducing manual work through creative scripting and automation
  • Finds satisfaction in mentoring others, running technical workshops or retrospectives, and modeling the behaviors and standards that elevate a DevOps culture
  • Feels called to our client's core values of being bold, powerful, and caring
  • Loves building trusting partnerships across Engineering, QA, and Services, and delights in transforming shared challenges into measurable outcomes

Our client is a U.S. fintech software company that offers innovative banking solutions to improve operations and enhance members' financial lives. The company has grown steadily since its inception over thirty years ago, with nearly 300 financial institutions across the United States, U.S. territories, and the Caribbean as customers. Backed by a large private equity company, our client is a recognized market leader helmed by financial industry veterans.


Responsibilities

  • Own and drive production system stability, respond to incidents, and improve reliability across critical services
  • Design, build, and maintain automation tooling to support internal teams and streamline cross-team workflows
  • Partner closely with Engineering, QA, and Services to scale DevOps maturity and accelerate delivery
  • Lead efforts to improve system monitoring, alerting, and recovery processes for high uptime and resilience
  • Mentor teammates, champion best practices, and contribute to onboarding, retrospectives, and training
  • Experiment with new tools, processes, and metrics to continuously advance DevOps excellence organization-wide


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps experience, preferably with ownership of production systems, automation, and reliability in complex environments
  • Deep experience with production operations, incident management, and reliability engineering for complex distributed systems
  • Strong proficiency in automation scripting, such as Python and Bash, and modern CI/CD pipelines
  • Hands-on background with major cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and infrastructure-as-code tools, such as Terraform, CloudFormation, and Ansible
  • Proven expertise with monitoring, alerting, and observability tools, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Datadog, in production environments
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor others, standardize processes, and drive adoption of best practices across teams
  • Strong collaborator, comfortable working cross-functionally with Engineering, QA, and Services
  • Familiarity with DevOps metrics and frameworks, such as DORA metrics and SRE practices, and a passion for data-driven improvement
  • Creative problem solver who thrives in a bold, influential, and caring team culture
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience; advanced degree or certifications in DevOps or Cloud


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support , enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData’s data feeds effectively.


We expect East Coast work hours.


As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients’ investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).
  • Collaborate with Product to improve product features based on client feedback.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline or finance-related field.
  • Experience in financial markets (Nice to have) ; excellent client-facing communication skills.
  • Experience working with US clients is highly preferred
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), SQL, Databricks (preferred), Jupyter, and AWS (Knowledge focused on answering clients’ questions).


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

Qualificações Obrigatórias

* Carteira de Clientes: Possuir uma carteira de clientes HNW própria e ativa e a capacidade comprovada de gerar negócios de alto volume.


Termos da Parceria e Remuneração


* Modelo: Parceiro Autônomo

* Remuneração: A remuneração desta posição é baseada em comissão, com ganhos superiores à média do mercado.

Os pagamentos são realizados em dólares (USD), oferecendo comissionamento mais bônus.


Suporte e Diferenciais

* Acesso direto e contínuo ao time de back-office nos EUA (jurídico, financeiro e operacional) para suporte em todas as etapas do fechamento.

Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.

Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

description:
About Kore Geosystems


Kore Geosystems is at the forefront of technology, leveraging AI and advanced software to deliver innovative solutions for the mining industry. Our products empower geologists and engineers to capture, manage, and analyze geological data faster and more accurately. With leadership experience from companies like Microsoft, our team combines deep technical expertise with a vision to transform how data powers mining operations.


The Opportunity


We’re seeking a hands-on Web Front-End Architect to lead Kore’s efforts in modern web application development. You’ll define and implement the front-end architecture for our next-generation platforms using ReactJS, TypeScript, Hooks, and Context API —while coding day-to-day.

This role requires deep technical ownership, architectural thinking, and the ability to work across multiple complex applications that integrate data visualization, analytics, and AI features.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead and own the front-end architecture and design of scalable, high-performance web applications.
  • Develop and maintain applications using ReactJS, TypeScript, Hooks, Context API , and Redux/Flux patterns.
  • Design responsive, modular, and reusable UI components using frameworks like Material UI , Bootstrap , or Tailwind .
  • Work closely with backend and DevOps teams to ensure seamless CI/CD integration (preferably on Azure DevOps ).
  • Implement secure front-end integrations with Azure AD B2C or equivalent identity systems.
  • Use SVG and D3.js for advanced data visualizations (annotations, charting, and reporting).
  • Collaborate with product, design, and data teams to translate complex requirements into intuitive, performant UI solutions.
  • Ensure accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and responsive design standards.
  • Drive front-end code quality, best practices, and technical mentorship within the team.


Required Skills & Experience


  • 15+ years of professional experience in front-end or full-stack web development.
  • Expert-level proficiency in:
  • ReactJS , TypeScript , Context API , Hooks , and Redux/Flux patterns
  • HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)
  • Solid understanding of Node.js concepts and front-end build pipelines.
  • Strong experience with responsive design frameworks (React Material, Bootstrap, Tailwind).
  • Hands-on experience with SVG and D3.js for visualizations.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred).
  • Familiarity with security best practices , OAuth2 , and Azure B2C authentication.
  • Strong debugging, optimization, and performance tuning skills.
  • 100% hands-on coding; ability to set architectural standards and lead by example.


Preferred Technologies


  • React Material Design
  • SVG / D3.js for data-driven UI
  • Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
  • Azure B2C for authentication and user management
  • React Router , Functional Components , and React Hooks


Who You Are


  • A technical leader who enjoys hands-on coding and architectural problem-solving.
  • Passionate about creating elegant, maintainable, and scalable UI systems.
  • Curious about data visualization, real-time apps, and next-gen UI technologies.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional, global teams.


Benefits


  • Health insurance for employee and family.
  • Two weeks of vacation + one week of sick leave annually.
  • Work-from-anywhere flexibility (Brazil only).
  • Annual performance bonus and salary revision.



Equal Opportunity


Kore Geosystems is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Conduzir a análise técnica do ambiente ServiceNow SPM , revisando arquitetura, integrações e fluxos de dados.

— Avaliar desempenho, segurança e aderência às boas práticas da plataforma, garantindo escalabilidade e sustentabilidade da solução.

— Mapear pontos de integração e revisar a escalabilidade técnica do ambiente.

— Identificar customizações existentes e avaliar o grau de aderência às funcionalidades nativas do ServiceNow.

— Avaliar prontidão para upgrade , riscos de compatibilidade e oportunidades de otimização.

— Recomendar ajustes técnicos, refactoring ou rollback quando necessário.

— Elaborar diagramas arquiteturais e documentação técnica detalhada.

— Apoiar o desenho de roadmaps técnicos e estratégias de melhoria contínua.

O que você precisa ter

— Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência com ServiceNow , incluindo participação em pelo menos 3 projetos SPM .

— Forte domínio técnico em arquitetura, integrações, performance e segurança .

— Experiência prática com CSDM, Flow Designer, Integration Hub e Performance Analytics .

— Certificação SPM-CIS fortemente desejável.

— CTA (Certified Technical Architect) ou CMA (Certified Master Architect) são diferenciais relevantes.

— Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em inglês e português.;

— Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and UI scaffolding to ensure an optimal user experience.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders of Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities operate and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Work closely with UI/UX designers to build, implement, and maintain scalable front-end applications, ensuring delivery of unparalleled user experiences
  • Architecture : Lead front-end architectural decisions, implementing best practices in performance optimization and responsive design
  • Leadership : Provide leadership within the development team, fostering a learning and growth environment
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments utilizing React.js
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience with Python, Golang, Node.js, or Java
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-ready machine learning systems and end-to-end pipelines on AWS.
  • Partner with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to define requirements, select algorithms, and deliver impactful ML solutions.
  • Architect, optimize, and maintain ML infrastructure — including data ingestion, model training, deployment, serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management — using AWS services.
  • Lead the data preparation and feature engineering process, ensuring data quality, integrity, and scalability across large datasets.
  • Implement and optimize ML models (supervised, unsupervised, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems) with a focus on performance, accuracy, and reliability.
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines and orchestration workflows to support ML systems at scale.
  • Integrate models into backend services and APIs, ensuring seamless interaction with applications and end users.
  • Contribute to MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model registries, experiment tracking, automated retraining, and infrastructure-as-code provisioning.
  • Utilize Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation to build and maintain scalable, secure ML infrastructure.
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI/ML, evaluating new research, frameworks, and tools to enhance product capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guiding best practices throughout the ML lifecycle.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.

  • Análise e Levantamento de Requisitos: Liderar sessões de discovery e entrevistas com stakeholders do setor elétrico para identificar, analisar, priorizar e documentar requisitos de negócio complexos.
  • Especificação Funcional e Técnica: Traduzir os requisitos de negócio em especificações funcionais detalhadas, Histórias de Usuário (User Stories) robustas, Casos de Uso e Critérios de Aceitação inequívocos, assegurando a conformidade com as regras de negócio e regulamentações do setor.

  • Interface Técnica (SME): Atuar como o Subject Matter Expert (SME) funcional para as equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e QA, garantindo o alinhamento técnico da solução com a especificação funcional e resolvendo impedimentos.
  • Validação e Garantia de Qualidade: Elaborar planos de testes funcionais e de integração. Conduzir e/ou suportar ativamente os Testes de Aceitação do Usuário (UAT), validando a aderência da entrega aos requisitos de negócio.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento: Criar e manter a documentação funcional dos sistemas e colaborar na elaboração de materiais de treinamento e manuais para os usuários finais.


Requisitos Essenciais


  • Formação: Superior completa em Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia (Elétrica, de Software, Produção) ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Análise: Experiência consolidada (mínimo de 5 anos) atuando como Analista Funcional, Analista de Negócios de TI ou Product Owner (PO) em projetos de desenvolvimento de software.

  • Metodologias: Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e práticas de engenharia de requisitos (elaboração de User Stories, BDD, etc.).
  • Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade analítica avançada para decompor problemas complexos, pensamento sistêmico e foco na solução de problemas de causa raiz.
  • Comunicação Interpessoal: Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e facilitação, capaz de atuar como tradutor eficaz entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Qualificações Desejáveis


  • Modelagem: Conhecimento avançado em notação BPMN e experiência com ferramentas de prototipação de interface (ex: Figma, Balsamiq).
  • Certificações: Certificações ativas em Análise de Negócios (ex: CBAP, PMI-PBA) ou Métodos Ágeis (ex: CSPO, PSPO).

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!
